method: Compare with DESI VI v1 and v3 TeX (Table 3 wCDM rows, Appendix A, Section 3, Section 5.3).
text: DESI VI's constant-w results are consistent with LCDM in all cases; swapping DESI's low-z BAO for SDSS (DESI VI Appendix A) reduces the significance by around half a sigma in each combination; the z = 0.51 LRG D_M/D_H point is the only DESI point significantly displaced from LCDM in DESI VI Fig. 1; with free curvature the results are very similar and centred on zero curvature.
rests_on: C4-C6 rely on the constant-w statement (in a Gaussian approximation w_p equals the constant-w estimate).
